lines.text: How can a self-driving car navigate bustling city streets without a human touching the wheel?
Autonomous vehicles use a superhuman fusion of cameras, radar, and laser LiDAR sensors.
Roof-mounted LiDAR units fire millions of invisible laser beams every second, bouncing off surroundings.
This creates a real-time, millimeter-accurate 3D point cloud map of the entire environment.
High-resolution AI neural networks classify every pixel into pedestrians, bicycles, lane lines, and stop signs.
The computer predicts where every moving object will be five seconds in the future to choose the safest path.
A self-driving car sees through darkness and rain far better than human eyes ever could.
